storyCards.fact:
Keri Hilson's "Turnin Me On" reached #15 on the Billboard Hot 100. Keri Lynn Hilson (born December 5, 1982) is an American singer-songwriter and actress.

The song peaked at #15 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

Turnin Me On was released in 2009.
